title: 第十一章 行政主管贺繁星第十二章 偶遇陈茜茜
content_zh:
“姜先生有什么要求？”甘敬问道。
“设计风格，中式，家具什么的，我都要最好的，然后……”姜辰说出了自己的想法。
前世今生，姜辰这是第一次买房装修。
所以，他心中十分的激动，以至于忘记了在他的面前是一个大美女。
片刻之后，姜辰说道：“……甘小姐，这些就是我的条件，不知道你的工作室能不能完成我的要求？”
“姜先生放心，我一定不会让你失望的。”甘敬在回国后一直在开工作室。不过虽然有江浩坤的帮助，但生意一直不是怎么的好。
这次聂星辰找到她，也是机缘巧合。
在知道姜辰准备设计装修豪宅的时候，她就下定决心一定要拿下这一单。
“好，我等你的好消息。”姜辰点点头。
甘敬的速度很快，仅仅是半个月就将设计图纸交给姜辰了。
“不错。”姜辰看到设计图纸，十分的满意。
“姜先生，我只是一个小小的工作室，所以，这装修的事，只能你自己找装修公司了。”甘敬说道。
“没关系，我自己就可以解决。”姜辰笑着说道：“甘小姐，你的设计非常的好，说不定以后我们就有合作的机会。”
“姜先生，借你吉言。”甘敬很快就告辞离开了。
姜辰拿着设计图纸，来到了奇妙装饰公司。
奇妙装饰公司是一家装修公司。
因为要装修君悦府豪宅，再加上以后自己开酒店也要装修，姜辰也没有去找其他的装修公司，而是在这半个月内收购了一家装修公司。
这家装修公司就是奇妙装饰公司。
之所以收购奇妙装饰公司，是因为奇妙装饰公司的老板有出售公司的打算，再加上这奇妙装饰公司也就几千万而已，所以，在聂星辰调查了几家装修公司的资料后，姜辰就选择了奇妙装饰公司。
奇妙装饰公司有自己的设计师和装修团队，也是姜辰看中的。

“请问你找谁？”
姜辰一到奇妙装饰公司，就被前台拦住了。
“我……”
“姜总。”
姜辰刚想说什么，一个声音传来。
“叶秘书。”姜辰看到来人，松了一口气。
她正是奇妙装饰公司前老板的秘书，之前在收购奇妙装饰公司的时候见过。
“姜总。”
叶秘书十分的恭敬。
“通知主管以上的所有高层开会。”姜辰说道。
“好的。”
叶秘书带着姜辰向办公室走去。
其他人议论了起来。
之前奇妙装饰公司被收购的消息他们也多多少少听到了风声。
甚至又少人生怕被下岗。
现在姜辰的出现，叶秘书的表现，他们都有忐忑不安的感觉。
一刻钟后，奇妙装饰公司所有主管级别的高层来到了会议室。
“相信大家都已经猜到了。”
content_en:
"What do you want from Mr. Jiang?" Gan Jing asked.
"Design style, Chinese style, furniture, etc., I want the best, and then..." Jiang Chen expressed his thoughts.
In his past life, this was Jiang Chen's first time buying a house and renovating it.
Therefore, he was so excited that he forgot that there was a beautiful woman in front of him.
After a while, Jiang Chen said: "...Miss Gan, these are my conditions. I wonder if your studio can fulfill my requirements?"
"Don't worry, Mr. Jiang, I won't let you down." Gan Jing has been opening a studio since returning to China. However, despite Jiang Haokun's help, business has not been very good.
It was also a coincidence that Nie Xingchen found her this time.
When she knew that Jiang Chen was going to design and decorate a mansion, she was determined to win the order.
"Okay, I'll wait for your good news." Jiang Chen nodded.
Gan Jing was very fast and handed over the design drawings to Jiang Chen in just half a month.
"Not bad." Jiang Chen was very satisfied when he saw the design drawings.
"Mr. Jiang, I am just a small studio, so you can only find a decoration company yourself for the decoration." Gan Jing said.
"It doesn't matter, I can solve it myself." Jiang Chen said with a smile: "Miss Gan, your design is very good. Maybe we will have the opportunity to cooperate in the future."
"Mr. Jiang, I'd like to lend you some kind words." Gan Jing quickly said goodbye and left.
Jiang Chen took the design drawings and came to Wonderful Decoration Company.
Wonderful Decoration Company is a decoration company.
Because he needed to renovate the Grand Hyatt Mansion, and also needed to renovate his own hotel in the future, Jiang Chen did not look for other decoration companies. Instead, he acquired a decoration company within the past half month.
This decoration company is Wonderful Decoration Company.
The reason for acquiring the Wonderful Decoration Company was that the owner of the Wonderful Decoration Company planned to sell the company. In addition, the Wonderful Decoration Company only cost tens of millions. Therefore, after Nie Xingchen investigated the information of several decoration companies, Jiang Chen chose the Wonderful Decoration Company.
Wonderful Decoration Company has its own designers and decoration team, which Jiang Chen also likes.
"Who are you looking for?"
As soon as Jiang Chen arrived at Wonderful Decoration Company, he was stopped by the front desk.
"I..."
"Mr. Jiang."
Just when Jiang Chen was about to say something, a voice came.
"Secretary Ye." Jiang Chen breathed a sigh of relief when he saw the person coming.
She was the secretary of the former owner of Wonderful Decoration Company, whom she had met before when the company was acquired.
"Mr. Jiang."
Secretary Ye was very respectful.
"Inform all senior executives above the supervisor to hold a meeting." Jiang Chen said.
"Okay."
Secretary Ye took Jiang Chen towards the office.
Others started talking.
They had also heard the news about the acquisition of Wonderful Decoration Company.
There are even a few people who are afraid of being laid off.
Now with Jiang Chen's appearance and Secretary Ye's behavior, they all felt uneasy.
A quarter of an hour later, all the senior executives of Wonderful Decoration Company came to the conference room.
"I believe everyone has guessed it."
